name: pro-ship
description: /pro-ship:pr-check runs a repo's own checks, the floor guard, a mutation check and fresh-context reviewers, then writes a stamp; a gate hook on gh pr create warns when the stamp is missing or stale. A risk classifier sorts each change into low, medium or high and a merge gate on gh pr merge asks for approval at medium and high, pinned to the head commit. In pro-dev-starter. The documentation-and-adrs skill, adapted from agent-skills, says which docs a change touches and how to write an ADR; docs are judgment, never a gate. Opt-in shipping plugin. Today it holds the Vercel deploy bridge: a deploy walk with its own token and .env checks that asks before staging, committing, pushing, linking, installing the CLI, an anonymous --temporary deploy or production. Install the upstream skill with /pro-dev install. Codex users use the bridge's install lines instead of /pro-ship:install.
